title: Finiteness of the next Serre-depth defect locus
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof reduces the next-depth defect to the preceding Serre level along a carefully chosen regular element. It then chooses that element so its complement lies entirely in the Cohen-Macaulay locus, leaving only the finitely many induction defects. This is a global finiteness argument for a depth-stratified locus.
